blocks.explanation: Yeh identity (aisa bayan jo letters ki har value ke liye sach ho) saabit karne wala sawal hai. Humein dikhana hai ke left-hand side (L.H.S.) aur right-hand side (R.H.S.) barabar hain. Qaida yeh hai ke hamesha mushkil side se shuru karein, yahan woh side jis mein \(\omega\) hai, kyunke use saada karna aasaan hai, ulta nahin. Plan: R.H.S. ke do \(\omega\) wale brackets ko pehle multiply karein, \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(\omega\) ko ghaib karein, aur phir \((x-y)\) se multiply karke L.H.S. tak pohanchein. Yeh asal mein difference of cubes ka formula hi hai, bas doosre bracket ko \(\omega\) ki madad se do linear factors mein tod diya gaya hai.
steps:
Step 1: R.H.S. ke do omega wale brackets multiply karein
\[(x-\omega y)(x-\omega^{2}y)\]
\[=x^{2}-\omega^{2}xy-\omega xy\]
\[\quad+\omega^{3}y^{2}\]
Kyun: Ek bracket ki har term ko doosre bracket ki har term se multiply kiya (chaar products). Aakhri product mein \((-\omega y)(-\omega^{2}y)=\omega^{3}y^{2}\), kyunke minus times minus plus hai aur \(\omega\cdot\omega^{2}=\omega^{3}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\omega\) ko bhi ek number ki tarah treat kijiye; us ki power alag rakhiye aur \(x,\ y\) ki powers alag.

Step 2: Omega ko ghaib karein
\[=x^{2}-(\omega+\omega^{2})xy+\omega^{3}y^{2}\]
\[=x^{2}+xy+y^{2}\]
Kyun: Beech ki do terms mein \(xy\) common tha, use bahar nikaala to bracket mein \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana jo \(-1\) hai; minus times minus se \(+xy\). Aur \(\omega^{3}=1\) se \(\omega^{3}y^{2}=y^{2}\). Dekhiye, \(\omega\) poori tarah gaya aur woh jaana pehchana bracket aa gaya jo difference of cubes mein hota hai.

Step 3: Pehle bracket se multiply karein
\[(x-y)(x^{2}+xy+y^{2})\]
\[=x^{3}+x^{2}y+xy^{2}\]
\[\quad-x^{2}y-xy^{2}-y^{3}\]
\[=x^{3}-y^{3}\]
Kyun: Pehle \(x\) ko bracket ki teeno terms se multiply kiya, phir \(-y\) ko. \(x^{2}y\) aur \(-x^{2}y\), aur \(xy^{2}\) aur \(-xy^{2}\) jori jori cancel ho gaye; sirf \(x^{3}-y^{3}\) bacha, jo L.H.S. hai.

Tasdeeq: x = 2, y = 1 rakh kar dekhein
\[\text{L.H.S.}=8-1=7\]
\[(2-\omega)(2-\omega^{2})\]
\[=4-2(\omega+\omega^{2})+\omega^{3}\]
\[=4+2+1=7\]
Kyun: \(x-y=1\) hai, is liye R.H.S. sirf aakhri do brackets ka product reh gaya. Dono sides 7 aayeen. Numbers rakh kar check karna identity ki ek achhi jaanch hai (lekin yeh saboot nahin, saboot upar wale steps hain).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x^{3}-y^{3}=(x-y)(x-\omega y)(x-\omega^{2}y)\). Matlab: \(\omega\) ki madad se \(x^{3}-y^{3}\) teen linear factors mein toot jaata hai.

blocks.explanation: Yeh identity (aisa bayan jo letters ki har value ke liye sach ho) saabit karne wala sawal hai. Humein dikhana hai ke left-hand side (L.H.S.) aur right-hand side (R.H.S.) barabar hain. Qaida yeh hai ke hamesha mushkil side se shuru karein, yahan woh side jis mein \(\omega\) hai, kyunke use saada karna aasaan hai, ulta nahin. Yeh part lamba hai lekin mushkil nahin; bas tartib (order) se chalna hai. Plan: pehle R.H.S. ke do \(\omega\) wale brackets ko row by row multiply karein (nau products), \(\omega^{3}=1\), \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) aur \(\omega+\omega^{2}=-1\) se \(\omega\) ghaib karein, phir \((x+y+z)\) se multiply karke cancel hone wali terms ko hata dein.
steps:
Step 1: Do omega wale brackets ko row by row multiply karein
\[x(\ldots)=x^{2}+\omega^{2}xy+\omega xz\]
\[\omega y(\ldots)=\omega xy+\omega^{3}y^{2}+\omega^{2}yz\]
\[\omega^{2}z(\ldots)=\omega^{2}xz+\omega^{4}yz+\omega^{3}z^{2}\]
Kyun: \((x+\omega y+\omega^{2}z)\) ki har term ko poore bracket \((x+\omega^{2}y+\omega z)\) se multiply kiya, ek line mein ek term. Is tarah nau products teen saaf lines mein aa gaye aur koi term chhooti nahin. Lambe multiplication mein yeh row by row tareeqa ghaltiyan bohat kam kar deta hai.

Step 2: Like terms ikatthi karein aur omega ghaib karein
\[x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\]
\[+(\omega+\omega^{2})xy\]
\[+(\omega^{2}+\omega)yz\]
\[+(\omega+\omega^{2})zx\]
\[=x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-xy-yz-zx\]
Kyun: Pehle \(\omega^{3}=1\) aur \(\omega^{4}=\omega^{3}\cdot\omega=\omega\) lagaya. Phir \(xy\) wali do terms, \(yz\) wali do terms aur \(zx\) wali do terms ko ikattha kiya; har jori ka coefficient (saath laga number) \(\omega+\omega^{2}\) bana, jo \(-1\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\omega^{4}yz\) ko \(\omega yz\) mein badalna na bhooliye, warna \(yz\) wali jori nahin banegi.

Step 3: (x + y + z) se multiply karein
\[x(\ldots)=x^{3}+xy^{2}+xz^{2}\]
\[\quad-x^{2}y-xyz-x^{2}z\]
\[y(\ldots)=x^{2}y+y^{3}+yz^{2}\]
\[\quad-xy^{2}-y^{2}z-xyz\]
\[z(\ldots)=x^{2}z+y^{2}z+z^{3}\]
\[\quad-xyz-yz^{2}-xz^{2}\]
Kyun: \(x\), \(y\) aur \(z\) ko baari baari \(x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}-xy-yz-zx\) ki chhe terms se multiply kiya. Phir se row by row, taake har line mein chhe terms hon aur ginti asaan rahe.

Step 4: Teeno lines jama karein
\[=x^{3}+y^{3}+z^{3}-3xyz\]
\[=\text{L.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(xy^{2}\), \(x^{2}y\), \(x^{2}z\), \(xz^{2}\), \(y^{2}z\), \(yz^{2}\) jaisi har term ek line mein plus aur doosri line mein minus ke saath aati hai, is liye cancel ho jaati hai. Sirf teen cubes aur teen dafa \(-xyz\) bachte hain, yaani \(-3xyz\).
Dhyan dein: cancel karte waqt har term par nishaan lagaate jaiye; \(-xyz\) teeno lines mein hai, use cancel nahin karna balke jama karna hai.

Tasdeeq: x = 1, y = 0, z = 0 rakhein
\[\text{L.H.S.}=1\]
\[\text{R.H.S.}=(1)(1)(1)=1\]
Kyun: Dono sides barabar aayeen. Ek aur jaanch: \(x=y=z=1\) rakhein to L.H.S. \(1+1+1-3=0\), aur R.H.S. mein \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) wala bracket aa jaata hai, to woh bhi 0. Dono jaanchein theek hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x^{3}+y^{3}+z^{3}-3xyz=(x+y+z)(x+\omega y+\omega^{2}z)(x+\omega^{2}y+\omega z)\). Yaani yeh mashhoor expression bhi \(\omega\) ki madad se teen linear factors mein toot jaata hai.

blocks.explanation: Yahan ek lamba product hai jis ke \(2n\) factors hain, aur humein dikhana hai ke poora product 1 hai. Itne saare factors dekh kar ghabraiye nahin; asal baat pattern pehchanna hai. Plan: har factor mein \(\omega\) ki power ko 3 se divide karke chhota karein. Phir aap dekhenge ke factors sirf do qisam ke hain, \((1+\omega)\) aur \((1+\omega^{2})\), jo baari baari aate hain. Ek jori ki value nikaal lein, phir jorian gin lein.
steps:
Step 1: Powers chhoti karein
\[\omega^{4}=\omega^{3}\cdot\omega=\omega\]
\[\omega^{8}=\omega^{6}\cdot\omega^{2}=\omega^{2}\]
\[\omega^{16}=\omega^{15}\cdot\omega=\omega\]
Kyun: Powers 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, ... har dafa double hoti hain, yaani har agli power pichli ka square hai. \(\omega\) ka square \(\omega^{2}\) hai, aur \(\omega^{2}\) ka square \(\omega^{4}=\omega\) hai. Is liye chhoti ki hui powers baari baari \(\omega,\ \omega^{2},\ \omega,\ \omega^{2},\ldots\) aati hain.

Step 2: Product dobara likhein
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\cdot(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\cdots\]
Kyun: Step 1 ke baad har do factors ki ek jaisi jori ban gayi: pehle \((1+\omega)\), phir \((1+\omega^{2})\), phir dobara wahi.

Step 3: Ek jori ki value
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})=(-\omega^{2})(-\omega)\]
\[=\omega^{3}=1\]
Kyun: \(1+\omega=-\omega^{2}\) aur \(1+\omega^{2}=-\omega\) (dono \(1+\omega+\omega^{2}=0\) se). Minus times minus plus hai, aur \(\omega^{2}\cdot\omega=\omega^{3}=1\).

Step 4: Jorian ginein
\[2n\text{ factors}=n\text{ pairs}\]
\[\text{Product}=1^{n}=1\]
Kyun: \(2n\) factors ki \(n\) jorian banti hain aur har jori 1 hai. 1 ko kitni bhi dafa multiply karein, 1 hi rehta hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh is liye kaam karta hai ke factors ki tadaad even (\(2n\)) hai. Agar odd hoti to aakhir mein ek akela \((1+\omega)\) bach jaata.

Tasdeeq: n = 1 seedha multiply karke
\[(1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})=1+\omega+\omega^{2}+\omega^{3}\]
\[=0+1=1\]
Kyun: Shortcut ke baghair pehli jori ko seedha khola: pehli teen terms ka jama 0 hai aur \(\omega^{3}=1\). Wahi 1 aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(2n\) factors ka product \(1\) hai. Matlab: har \((1+\omega)(1+\omega^{2})\) wali jori 1 ke barabar hai.
